structured_output.summary: Created starlette/middleware/body_limit.py with RequestBodyLimitMiddleware and tests/middleware/test_body_limit.py. I couldn't run commands here, so none of the tests have been run. The outermost instance keeps shared state in scope["starlette.body_limit"] (limit, received, response_started). It wraps receive to count bytes and wraps send to track whether a response has started. A nested instance only overrides the limit and does its own Content-Length fail-fast, so bytes aren't double counted. When the limit is crossed it raises RequestBodyLimitExceeded, and the outermost instance catches it and sends a plain-text 413 only if no response has started. Once the limit is crossed, further receive calls keep raising.

criteria_notes.note: test_over_limit_without_content_length, test_streaming_body_counted and test_multipart_counted_including_overhead check the 413 and the 'Content Too Large' text/plain body, and the multipart test checks that encoding overhead is counted.
test_no_second_response_when_response_started checks that only http.response.start was sent and that receive raised. test_receive_keeps_raising_after_limit_crossed checks the stream stays stopped.
